welcome:
Welcome to the Trivy CLI Playground.
Simulated security scanner for container images, filesystems, and Kubernetes.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

scenarios.title: Scan and Fix Container Image Vulnerabilities

steps.instruction: Scan the nginx image for all vulnerabilities.
Too noisy. Filter for HIGH and CRITICAL only.
Show only vulnerabilities that have a fix available.
Generate a JSON report for CI.
steps.hint: Try: trivy image --format json --output report.json myregistry/api:v2.1.0

steps.instruction: Check if image passes CI gate (exit 1 on CRITICAL).

steps.hint: Try: trivy image --format cyclonedx --output sbom.json myregistry/api:v2.1.0

steps.instruction: Scan the project filesystem for vulnerabilities and secrets.
Filter config scan to HIGH and CRITICAL.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  trivy image        — Scan container images
  trivy fs           — Scan filesystem
  trivy config       — Scan IaC (Terraform, K8s YAML, Dockerfile)
  trivy k8s          — Scan Kubernetes cluster
  trivy repo         — Scan remote git repository
  trivy rootfs       — Scan root filesystem
  trivy sbom         — Scan SBOM file
  trivy plugin       — Manage plugins
  trivy version      — Show version

  Flags: --severity, --format, --ignore-unfixed, --exit-code, --scanners

  scenario           — Start a guided lab
  clear              — Clear terminal
  help               — Show this help
